tagline: Deterministic spec-to-application compiler — zero LLM in codegen.
keyFeatures: 4-stage deterministic pipeline: parse_prd → genome → render → pack
10 ecosystem CLIs (npm, pip, go install, composer, gem, cargo, dotnet)
Complete bootable output — auth, migrations, docker-compose, ARCHITECTURE.md
Offline / air-gapped — no LLM API in generation path
Level 4 Spec-to-Application — same spec → same ZIP every time
limitations: Greenfield only — spec changes trigger full regeneration, not delta edits
No brownfield or in-repo agent workflow (complements Spec-Kit, does not replace it)
No IDE integration or slash commands
Ambiguous PRDs produce simpler output rather than LLM guessing
No built-in git worktree or parallel feature isolation
